title: 奥尔德温之家迎宾礼品建造表
instruction:
您是 Aldwin House 住宅俱乐部的礼宾协调员，负责为 Stonebridge Partners 的企业会员区准备欢迎套装，Nadia Alcantara 和 Laila Okonkwo 通过 Redcliffe 学区计划协调抵达事宜。第一批货将于 10 月初开始，会员总监 Callum Rewi 需要一张可重复使用的构建表，以便桌面团队能够生产一致的套装，而无需依赖 Amira Fontanel 亲自组装每件套装。使用随附的`amenity_catalog.xlsx`了解可用物品、包装尺寸、饮食标签和单位成本，使用`supplier_terms.docx`了解供应商最低限度、等级折扣、交货时间以及将建议的套餐与津贴进行比较的商定方式，使用`corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx`了解到达日期、数量和饮食要求。在工作目录的顶层创建`welcome_amenity_build_sheet.xlsx`。将工作簿保留为真正的空白工具：工作人员输入的到货详细信息、选定的数量、注释和最终批准字段在打开时必须为空，而参考数据和公式可能已经存在。工作簿必须按顺序使用工作表 `Instructions`、`Reference Data`、`Build Sheet` 和 `Weekly Check`。
它将在礼宾台打印和使用，然后保留以供监督审查，因此使工作视图易于导航并在一张A4横向页面上打印。构建表需要一个明确的位置来记录到达日期、公司帐户、套装数量、饮食概况、选定的便利数量、供应商或包装选择、运行成本、津贴差异、准备交付时间状态以及批准/签核。包括饮食概况、供应商和状态的受控选择，而不是自由格式的代码，并使表格明显地区分超额津贴或延迟订购条件与可接受的条件。工作人员需要能够将拟议的信封与所提供的假设下津贴的最佳可行用途进行比较，而无需工作簿悄悄地替换某个项目或为其填充空白选项。每周检查必须使用与构建表相同的到货数量，汇总相关的每周支出和容量检查，并在工作人员未输入到货的情况下保留空白。请勿添加徽标、发明的便利设施或完成的示例选择；使用上面的文件名写入单个文件。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：
- `references/amenity_catalog.xlsx` — 提供工作簿参考和计算区域使用的所提供的便利设施目录、包装尺寸、饮食分类、供应商、单位成本以及项目标识符。
- `references/supplier_terms.docx` — 向供应商提供最低订单阈值、等级折扣条件、准备交付周期、膳食替代当量、津贴和比较假设。
- `references/corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx` — 提供执行可重复使用的计划字段和每周检查所需的完整到达预测、日期、设定数量、帐户标签和饮食要求。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `welcome_amenity_build_sheet.xlsx` — 供礼宾人员使用的空白、公式驱动的欢迎设施构建表，包含参考数据、受控输入、可行性检查、津贴比较和每周监督视图。 （必须是一个 .xlsx 工作簿，其中按顺序精确地包含工作表说明、参考数据、构建表和每周检查。；操作工具必须在没有完成示例选择或填写人员输入结果的情况下打开。；公式、命名范围、验证列表、条件格式、打印设置和链接数量字段必须作为工作簿对象实现，而不是粘贴的输出值。；构建表和每周检查必须在A4横向上以一页宽清晰打印。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Aldwin House Residence Club — Supplier Terms
Corporate membership welcome amenity programme | issued 12 September 2026
Use these conventions when preparing a per-arrival envelope. The allowance is fixed at £35.00 per set. “Close to best achievable” means compare the proposed envelope with the highest-scoring feasible candidate under the allowance, applicable weekly threshold, lead-time and dietary constraints; do not silently substitute a line.
Supplier
Weekly minimum (sets)
Discount threshold (sets)
Discount
Lead time (days)
Harbour Pantry
20
20
10%
2
North Quay Patisserie
8
8
5%
5
House Stock
0
0
0%
1
Discount applies only when the applicable weekly minimum is reached. A same-week booking for North Quay Patisserie is not feasible when the arrival is fewer than 5 days away. Dietary alternatives marked as equivalent are approved choices of equal welcome value, not lesser gifts; never approve an incompatible dietary tag.
Controlled vocabulary: dietary profile = Standard, Nut-free, Halal. Preparation status = Not started, In preparation, Ready, Exception. Approval status = Pending, Reviewed, Approved. Supplier = Harbour Pantry, North Quay Patisserie, House Stock.
Required per-arrival fields: arrival date, corporate account, set quantity, dietary profile, chosen item and quantity lines, supplier/pack choice, notes, preparation status and approval/sign-off.

sheets.name: Instructions
rows: Aldwin House Residence Club | Welcome Amenity Build Sheet
Blank per-arrival instrument for Stonebridge Partners corporate arrivals; complete only when an arrival is being prepared.
Enter blue cells on Build Sheet. Select controlled values from drop-downs, choose every item explicitly, and record quantities in units per set. Formula cells are shaded grey.
Green = feasible/acceptable. Amber = review (near best or threshold). Red = over allowance, late, dietary-incompatible, or exception; escalate before approval.
£35.00 per set. Variance is running cost less allowance (negative means room remains). Discounts apply only when the relevant weekly minimum is met.
Dietary alternatives are approved equivalent choices, not inferior gifts. Never silently replace a selected item; choose an approved equivalent and document the decision.
Blank input cells are intentional until staff prepare an arrival. Blank inputs produce neutral calculated outputs and no implied approval.
Best achievable score uses the highest-scoring feasible catalogue candidate under allowance, dietary profile, lead-time window, and the applicable weekly discount threshold.

sheets.name: Reference Data
rows: Reference Data | Catalogue, Terms, Lists & Forecast
Highest-scoring feasible candidate; no silent substitutions
Fewer than 5 days before arrival is not feasible
Forecast is context only; never copy it into Build Sheet entry cells.

criteria.description: 提交的工作簿是一个 .xlsx 文件，其中包含按顺序排列的工作表“说明”、“参考数据”、“构建表”和“每周检查”。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表列表和顺序。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作簿.sheetnames；如果存在额外的隐藏或可见纸张，则不予奖励。

original.criterion: The submitted workbook is an .xlsx file with exactly the sheets Instructions, Reference Data, Build Sheet, and Weekly Check, in that order.
original.evidence: Workbook sheet list and order.
original.grader_hint: Inspect workbook.sheetnames; do not award if extra hidden or visible sheets are present.

criteria.description: 参考数据表包含提供的目录记录，其中包含稳定的商品标识符、名称、类别、供应商、包装尺寸、成本和饮食标签。
criteria.evidence: 引用数据单元格或表格对象。
criteria.grader_hint: 将字段和记录与amenity_catalog.xlsx进行比较；允许呈现差异。

original.criterion: The Reference Data sheet contains the supplied catalogue records with stable item identifiers, names, categories, suppliers, pack sizes, costs, and dietary tags.
original.evidence: Reference Data cells or table object.
original.grader_hint: Compare fields and records to amenity_catalog.xlsx; allow presentation differences.

criteria.description: 参考数据表包含公式所需的供应商条款、阈值、提前期、折扣、津贴、受控列表和预测上下文。
criteria.evidence: 参考数据表和命名范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查supplier_terms.docx和corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx，包括低于最低值和提前到达的情况。

original.criterion: The Reference Data sheet contains the supplier terms, thresholds, lead times, discounts, allowance, controlled lists, and forecast context needed by the formulas.
original.evidence: Reference Data tables and named ranges.
original.grader_hint: Check against supplier_terms.docx and corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx, including the below-minimum and early-arrival cases.

criteria.description: 说明表将工作簿标识为空白的到达工具，并解释了输入、公式输出和警报的含义。
criteria.evidence: 说明表文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 新的桌面用户应该能够区分输入单元、计算单元和异常状态。

original.criterion: The Instructions sheet identifies the workbook as a blank per-arrival instrument and explains the meaning of inputs, formula outputs, and alerts.
original.evidence: Instructions sheet text.
original.grader_hint: A new desk user should be able to distinguish entry cells, calculated cells, and exception states.

criteria.description: 说明书解释说，饮食替代品是经批准的同等选择，而不是较少的礼物。
criteria.evidence: 说明表文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的等效/替代语言，而不仅仅是“无坚果”或“清真”等词。

original.criterion: The Instructions sheet explains that dietary alternatives are approved equivalent choices rather than lesser gifts.
original.evidence: Instructions sheet text.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit equivalent/substitution language, not merely the words nut-free or halal.

criteria.description: 构建表包括用于到达日期、公司帐户、组数和饮食概况的空白输入字段。
criteria.evidence: 构建工作表标签和相应的单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 文件打开时，验证用于人员输入的单元格不包含文本、数字或公式。

original.criterion: The Build Sheet includes blank entry fields for arrival date, corporate account, number of sets, and dietary profile.
original.evidence: Build Sheet labels and corresponding cells.
original.grader_hint: Verify the cells intended for staff entry contain no text, number, or formula when the file opens.

criteria.description: 构建表包括空白的员工输入字段，用于项目选择、数量、供应商或适用的包装选择、注释、准备状态和批准/签字。
criteria.evidence: 构建工作表输入网格和签核区域。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查这些是可用的输入单元格并且不是预先填充的示例。

original.criterion: The Build Sheet includes blank staff-entry fields for item choice, quantity, supplier or pack choice where applicable, notes, preparation status, and approval/sign-off.
original.evidence: Build Sheet entry grid and sign-off area.
original.grader_hint: Check that these are usable input cells and are not prefilled examples.

criteria.description: 饮食概况输入有一个数据验证列表，其中完全包含标准、无坚果和清真食品。
criteria.evidence: Excel 数据验证对象。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查验证公式/列表值，而不仅仅是可见的说明。

original.criterion: The dietary profile input has a data-validation list containing exactly Standard, Nut-free, and Halal.
original.evidence: Excel dataValidation object.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the validation formula/list values, not just visible instructions.

criteria.description: 供应商选择使用数据验证列表，其中包含 Harbour Pantry、North Quay Patisserie 和 House Stock。
criteria.evidence: Excel 数据验证对象。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查实际允许值。

original.criterion: Supplier choice uses a data-validation list containing exactly Harbour Pantry, North Quay Patisserie, and House Stock.
original.evidence: Excel dataValidation object.
original.grader_hint: Check the actual allowed values.

criteria.description: 准备状态使用精确包含“未开始”、“准备中”、“就绪”和“异常”的数据验证列表。
criteria.evidence: Excel 数据验证对象。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查实际允许值。

original.criterion: Preparation status uses a data-validation list containing exactly Not started, In preparation, Ready, and Exception.
original.evidence: Excel dataValidation object.
original.grader_hint: Check the actual allowed values.

criteria.description: 批准状态使用精确包含“待处理”、“已审核”和“已批准”的数据验证列表。
criteria.evidence: Excel 数据验证对象。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查实际允许值。

original.criterion: Approval status uses a data-validation list containing exactly Pending, Reviewed, and Approved.
original.evidence: Excel dataValidation object.
original.grader_hint: Check the actual allowed values.

criteria.description: 每个便利设施行成本都是一个公式，源自选定的商品、数量、包装尺寸和适用的成本或供应商条款，而不是粘贴的常量。
criteria.evidence: 线路成本公式和参考目录/术语范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查配方标记并测试副本中更改的数量或目录成本；线路成本应该更新。

original.criterion: Each amenity line cost is a formula that derives from the selected item, quantity, pack size, and applicable cost or supplier term rather than a pasted constant.
original.evidence: Line-cost formulas and referenced catalogue/terms ranges.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formula tokens and test a changed quantity or catalogue cost in a copy; the line cost should update.

criteria.description: 运行总计由公式驱动，包括通过最终边界线的所有预期便利设施线。
criteria.evidence: 公式范围总计。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 SUM 或等效范围是否包括最后一行并排除不相关的单元格。

original.criterion: The running total is formula-driven and includes all intended amenity lines through the final boundary line.
original.evidence: Grand-total formula range.
original.grader_hint: Inspect that the SUM or equivalent range includes the last line and excludes unrelated cells.

criteria.description: 津贴方差是一个将运行总计与参考数据的津贴进行比较的公式。
criteria.evidence: 津贴和方差公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认津贴是从提供的条款中引用的，而不是在输出单元格中硬编码的。

original.criterion: The allowance variance is a formula comparing the running total with the allowance from Reference Data.
original.evidence: Allowance and variance formulas.
original.grader_hint: Confirm allowance is referenced from the supplied terms, not hard-coded in the output cell.

criteria.description: 用于每次到达计算的数量通过公式链接到输入的组数，并且不在其他地方独立输入。
criteria.evidence: 构建工作表公式和输入单元格结构。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪家属/参考人；到达设定数量必须有一个来源输入。

original.criterion: The quantity used for the per-arrival calculation is formula-linked to the number-of-sets input and is not independently typed elsewhere.
original.evidence: Build Sheet formulas and input-cell structure.
original.grader_hint: Trace dependents/references; there must be one source input for the arrival set quantity.

criteria.description: 构建表根据相关的每周数量和阈值计算是否满足供应商折扣资格，而不是始终应用折扣。
criteria.evidence: 折扣资格和调整后成本公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 IF/查找逻辑并测试每周低于阈值和高于阈值的数量。

original.criterion: The Build Sheet calculates whether supplier discount eligibility is met from the relevant weekly quantity and threshold, rather than always applying the discount.
original.evidence: Discount eligibility and adjusted-cost formulas.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the IF/lookup logic and test a below-threshold and above-threshold weekly quantity.

criteria.description: 该工作簿公开了公式驱动的提前期状态，当所选项目需要更多提前期时，该状态可识别同周预订。
criteria.evidence: 提前期计算和状态公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用优质糕点店和其所需的提前窗口内的到达日期进行测试。

original.criterion: The workbook exposes a formula-driven lead-time status that identifies a same-week booking when the selected item requires more lead time.
original.evidence: Lead-time calculation and status formula.
original.grader_hint: Test with the premium patisserie and an arrival date inside its required lead window.

criteria.description: 该工作簿公开了公式驱动的饮食适宜性或例外结果，该结果不会默默地批准不兼容的选择。
criteria.evidence: 饮食标签查找和适宜性公式。

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含在所提供的假设下对建议的包络线与最佳可行的可实现包络线进行公式驱动的比较。

original.criterion: The comparison output distinguishes a feasible proposed envelope from one that is over allowance, late, or dietary-incompatible.
original.evidence: Formula status logic.
original.grader_hint: Change inputs in a copy and verify the status changes appropriately.

criteria.description: 每周检查包含链接的到达/设定数量，其公式引用构建表数量输入。

original.criterion: The arrival/set quantity shown on Weekly Check agrees exactly with the Build Sheet quantity whenever the Build Sheet quantity is populated.
original.evidence: Linked cells and recalculated workbook values.
original.grader_hint: Enter several quantities in a copy and compare both sheets; duplicates or independent inputs fail.

criteria.description: 工作簿打开时，所有员工输入、批准、选择、数量和签核单元格均为空，而参考表、标签、验证、公式和说明仍然存在。

original.grader_hint: Audit the defined input ranges for absence of text, numbers, and formulas; do not treat reference-data rows as staff-entry examples.

criteria.description: 空白输入产生空白或明确中立的计算输出，而不是误导已完成的决策、零成本批准或错误的例外清除。

original.criterion: The final total cell is a formula rather than a constant and its formula range reaches the last amenity line.

spec.professional_context: Aldwin House Residence Club is preparing a corporate membership arrival programme. The deliverable is an operational spreadsheet for concierge staff and later review by the membership director or compliance reviewer.
difficulty_sources: Balancing allowance utilization, supplier thresholds, lead time, dietary suitability, and presentation quality
Turning complete reference information into a reusable blank instrument rather than a completed answer
Maintaining dependent formulas and agreement between the arrival quantity and weekly planning views

amenity_catalog.xlsx.records: Create a compact but varied catalogue containing ordinary, premium, nut-free, halal, and patisserie options. Every record needs a stable item code, display name, category, supplier, pack size, unit cost, dietary tags, and a usable quantity unit. Include at least one item whose pack size differs from the apparent serving count so quantity conversion is necessary.
imperfections_to_include: Include duplicate-looking catalogue descriptions with distinct item codes and different suppliers.
Include at least one item that is not available for a required dietary profile and at least one equivalent dietary substitution.
Include a premium patisserie option whose lead-time limitation matters for early arrivals.

supplier_terms.docx.content: State the fixed per-arrival allowance, the objective/comparison assumptions for judging an envelope, supplier weekly minimums, tier discount thresholds, lead times, and the treatment of dietary substitutions. Make clear that a discount applies only when the applicable weekly minimum is reached and that a same-week patisserie booking is not feasible.
local_conventions: Use exact controlled vocabulary for dietary profile, supplier, order status, and preparation status.
Define the required fields and formula relationships the workbook must expose.

State the agreed interpretation of 'close to best achievable' as a comparison against the highest-scoring feasible candidate under the supplied allowance, threshold, lead-time, and dietary constraints.

corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx.records: Provide a small October forecast spanning multiple weeks, with arrival date, account, number of sets, dietary profile, and booking status. Include at least one week below a supplier discount minimum and one early arrival that makes the premium patisserie unavailable.
corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx.relationship: The forecast quantity is the supplied context for the reusable instrument but must not be copied into staff-entry cells as a completed example.

instructions.purpose: Explain the downstream use, blank-entry convention, controlled vocabulary, meaning of visual alerts, formula-driven fields, and how the allowance comparison should be interpreted.
required_objects: A concise legend for acceptable, warning, and exception states
A note that dietary alternatives are equivalent approved choices, not inferior gifts
A statement that blank input cells are intentionally blank until an arrival is being prepared

reference_data.purpose: Hold the supplied catalogue, terms, controlled lists, and forecast data used by formulas and validations.
required_objects: Catalogue table with stable item codes and cost/pack/dietary fields
Terms table containing allowance, thresholds, discounts, lead times, and comparison assumptions
Validation lists for dietary profile, supplier, preparation status, booking status, and approval status
Forecast table with arrival dates and quantities

build_sheet.purpose: A blank per-arrival instrument used at the desk.
required_sections: Amenity selection grid with item code/name, quantity, pack or supplier choice, dietary suitability, and line cost
Lead-time, threshold/discount, feasibility, and best-achievable comparison outputs
formula_requirements: Line costs derive from selected catalogue records, pack sizes, quantities, and applicable terms.
The total includes every intended line through the final boundary line and no extra blank line.
Allowance variance, lead-time status, discount eligibility, feasibility, and comparison status are dependent outputs.
Blank inputs should produce blank or clearly neutral outputs rather than misleading zeros or completed decisions.
A comparison calculation evaluates feasible candidate combinations from the supplied catalogue and terms, and reports how close the proposed envelope is to the best achievable score.
build_sheet.boundary_feature: Place the grand total on the final amenity line or immediately following it so omission of the last line is a meaningful off-by-one risk.

weekly_check.purpose: Provide a compact oversight view for the selected arrival/week without creating a second source of truth.
required_objects: A linked arrival quantity that agrees with the Build Sheet quantity
Formula-driven weekly set count, projected spend, threshold status, and lead-time exception count
Blank or neutral results when no arrival/week has been entered

physical_use.use_case: Printed at the concierge desk for handwritten notes beside a phone, then reviewed electronically.
navigation: Freeze the useful header area on data-heavy sheets.
Keep input cells visually distinct from formula and reference cells.
Use conditional formatting for over allowance, late preparation, unavailable dietary choice, and feasible/near-best status.

gold_derivation.formula_audit: Open the produced workbook with openpyxl and inspect formulas, named ranges, data validations, conditional formatting, sheet order, print settings, number formats, and blank input cells.
gold_derivation.relationship_audit: Recalculate independently from the supplied catalogue, terms, and forecast; verify that formulas express the stated relationships rather than hard-coded answers.
gold_derivation.blank_audit: Confirm all staff-entry and approval cells are empty on open, while reference tables and instructions are populated.
gold_derivation.render_audit: Render or print the Build Sheet and Weekly Check to confirm one-page-wide A4 landscape usability.

reference_files.discovery: Open the workbook supplied in the working directory; use the catalogue as the source for all selectable amenity records and costs.

reference_files.purpose: Provides the supplier minimum-order thresholds, tier discount conditions, preparation lead times, dietary substitution equivalence, allowance, and comparison assumptions.
reference_files.discovery: Read the supplied Word document before constructing the calculation logic; its tables and notes are the controlling local conventions for this instrument.

reference_files.purpose: Provides the complete arrival forecast, dates, set quantities, account labels, and dietary requirements needed to exercise the reusable planning fields and weekly checks.
reference_files.discovery: Open the supplied workbook and use its values as the supplied planning context; do not alter the source file.

deliverables.description: A blank, formula-driven welcome-amenity build sheet for concierge use, with reference data, controlled inputs, feasibility checks, allowance comparison, and a weekly oversight view.
constraints: Must be an .xlsx workbook with exactly the sheets Instructions, Reference Data, Build Sheet, and Weekly Check, in that order.
The operational instrument must open without completed example selections or filled staff-entered results.
Formulas, named ranges, validation lists, conditional formatting, print settings, and linked quantity fields must be implemented as workbook objects rather than pasted output values.
The Build Sheet and Weekly Check must print clearly at one page wide on A4 landscape.

title_original: aldwin house welcome amenity build sheet
original_instruction:
You are the concierge coordinator at Aldwin House Residence Club, preparing the welcome sets for Stonebridge Partners’ corporate membership block, with Nadia Alcantara and Laila Okonkwo coordinating arrivals through the Redcliffe School District programme. The first arrivals begin in early October, and Membership Director Callum Rewi needs a reusable build sheet so the desk team can produce consistent sets without relying on Amira Fontanel to assemble every one personally. Use the attached `amenity_catalog.xlsx` for the available items, pack sizes, dietary tags, and unit costs, `supplier_terms.docx` for supplier minimums, tier discounts, lead times, and the agreed way to compare a proposed set with the allowance, and `corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx` for the arrival dates, quantities, and dietary requirements. Create `welcome_amenity_build_sheet.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory. Keep the workbook as a genuinely blank instrument: staff-entered arrival details, selected quantities, notes, and final approval fields must be empty when it opens, while reference data and formulas may already be present. The workbook must use the sheets `Instructions`, `Reference Data`, `Build Sheet`, and `Weekly Check`, in that order. It will be printed and used at the concierge desk, then retained for an oversight review, so make the working view easy to navigate and print on one A4 landscape page wide. The Build Sheet needs a clear place for the arrival date, corporate account, number of sets, dietary profile, selected amenity quantities, supplier or pack choice, running cost, allowance variance, preparation lead-time status, and approval/sign-off. Include controlled choices for dietary profile, supplier, and status rather than free-form codes, and make the sheet visibly distinguish an over-allowance or late-order condition from an acceptable one. Staff need to be able to compare a proposed envelope with the best feasible use of the allowance under the supplied assumptions, without the workbook quietly substituting an item or filling a blank choice for them. The Weekly Check must use the same arrival quantity as the Build Sheet, summarize the relevant weekly spend and capacity checks, and remain blank where staff have not entered an arrival. Do not add a logo, invented amenities, or completed example selections; write the single file with exactly the filename above.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/amenity_catalog.xlsx` — Provides the supplied amenity catalogue, pack sizes, dietary classifications, suppliers, unit costs, and item identifiers used by the workbook's reference and calculation areas.
- `references/supplier_terms.docx` — Provides the supplier minimum-order thresholds, tier discount conditions, preparation lead times, dietary substitution equivalence, allowance, and comparison assumptions.
- `references/corporate_arrival_forecast.xlsx` — Provides the complete arrival forecast, dates, set quantities, account labels, and dietary requirements needed to exercise the reusable planning fields and weekly checks.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `welcome_amenity_build_sheet.xlsx` — A blank, formula-driven welcome-amenity build sheet for concierge use, with reference data, controlled inputs, feasibility checks, allowance comparison, and a weekly oversight view. (Must be an .xlsx workbook with exactly the sheets Instructions, Reference Data, Build Sheet, and Weekly Check, in that order.; The operational instrument must open without completed example selections or filled staff-entered results.; Formulas, named ranges, validation lists, conditional formatting, print settings, and linked quantity fields must be implemented as workbook objects rather than pasted output values.; The Build Sheet and Weekly Check must print clearly at one page wide on A4 landscape.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
